text: 'Happily Ever Faster' to orbit 🌌 ✨ Today we launched our 95th Electron at 3:28 pm NZST and deployed a single Earth observation satellite to a 500km LEO for a confidential customer - our 16th mission of the year with 100% mission success.

For the first time, we're opening our doors at Wallops Island for an exclusive hiring event at Launch Complexes 2 and 3. We welcome engineers and technicians who are exceptionally good at what they do and want to see technology they helped build leave the planet. Accepted candidates will get the rare opportunity to tour our launch pads and facilities, meet with our engineering teams, and interview one-on-one with department leaders Open Positions: 🔧 Testing Engineers – Vehicle, Avionics, Launch Pad 🔧 Ground Systems Engineers 🔧 Vehicle Integration Engineers 🔧 Mechanical Technicians 🔧 Senior Vehicle Integration and Test Technicians 🔧 Fluids Engineers 🔧 Propulsion Engineers Apply here: https://t.co/q4vpDoIV6M

For the last three decades, conventional, multi-junction solar cells have largely relied on germanium wafers. Today, Rocket Lab announced the production release of IMM Apex, our germanium-free new high-efficiency solar cell to reduce reliance on the supply-constrained critical metals.
